title: Unexpected renewal and invoice review
body: For an unexpected renewal, confirm the account email, invoice number, renewal date and plan before changing billing. Route disputed renewal charges to Billing Review. Do not promise a refund before the billing team checks eligibility.

title: Recovering access to an account
body: For account access issues, verify the user through the approved identity process, check whether a recovery email is available, and use the password reset flow. Never ask a user to share their password or authentication code. Escalate suspected account takeover to Security.

title: Inviting and removing workspace members
body: Workspace administrators can invite a member from Settings and assign the least access needed for their role. Before removing a member, confirm ownership of their active projects and transfer those projects to another administrator. Record the change in the workspace activity log.

title: Preparing a workspace data export
body: A workspace administrator can request an export from Settings. Confirm the workspace and date range, explain that large exports may take time, and share the download only with an authorised workspace administrator. Escalate missing or incomplete export files to Data Operations.

title: Report dates and time zones
body: Report date filters use the time zone shown in workspace settings. If totals appear different, compare the selected time range, time zone and any active filters before treating the report as incorrect. Include those details when escalating a reproducible mismatch to Analytics Support.

title: Reconnecting a disconnected integration
body: When an integration disconnects, check the connection status, the last successful sync and any recent permission changes. Ask a workspace administrator to reconnect through the approved authorisation flow. Do not request or store access tokens in a support ticket. Escalate repeated failures with the integration name and sync timestamp.

title: Document indexing and source refresh
body: If an AI answer does not reflect a recently changed document, confirm that the file is supported, available to the workspace and included in the connected source. Check the last indexing time and request a refresh if the source is eligible. Answers should cite the source passages used; report missing citations with the question and document name.

title: Data retention and deletion requests
body: For a request to delete personal or workspace data, record the requester, workspace and data category, then route it to the Privacy team using the approved request process. Do not promise a completion date or manually delete records. Confirm receipt without exposing another person's data.

title: Escalating a suspected security incident
body: For suspected unauthorised access or data exposure, preserve relevant timestamps and ticket details, avoid sharing sensitive information in public channels, and immediately notify the Security response contact. Do not attempt to investigate beyond approved support steps or assure the customer that no data was affected.
